name: SkillHive
description: For authorized employees: find company skills and explore or submit business requirements. A company-issued SkillHive token is required.
description_zh: 供已获授权的企业员工查找公司 Skill、探索并提交业务需求；使用前须由企业管理员签发 SkillHive 员工令牌。
description_en: For authorized employees: find company skills and explore or submit business requirements. A company-issued SkillHive token is required.
examples_zh: 帮我找一个整理周报的公司 Skill
列出我可以使用的企业 Skill
帮我探索一个业务需求
继续我上次的需求讨论
examples_en: Find a company skill for preparing weekly reports
List the enterprise skills I can use
Help me explore a business requirement
